tx.name: Dentistry
tx.short: The most common reason my patients come. From single crowns to a complete smile makeover.
tx.meta_title: Dental treatment in Istanbul: veneers, crowns, implants, Hollywood Smile | Irena
tx.meta_description: Veneers, crowns, implants and Hollywood Smile in Istanbul with personal support in Polish, Ukrainian or Russian. Treatment plan and quote before you travel, free consultation.
tx.lead: Veneers, crowns, implants and complete smile makeovers. I choose the doctor and interpret every visit, and you get your plan and quote before you travel.
tx.wa: Hello Irena! I am interested in dental treatment in Istanbul.

facts.label: typical stay for veneers and crowns
for implants, a few months apart
a panoramic one is enough for a first estimate

tx.proc_intro: I help with simple and very extensive treatment alike. The final plan is always set by the doctor after an examination.

procedures.name: Hollywood Smile
procedures.text: A complete smile makeover: veneers or crowns on the visible teeth, matched in shape and shade to your face.

procedures.name: Porcelain veneers
procedures.text: Thin shells on the front of the teeth. They correct colour, shape and small irregularities.

procedures.name: Crowns
procedures.text: Zirconia or porcelain. They restore damaged teeth, teeth after root canal treatment or with large fillings.

procedures.name: Implants
procedures.text: They replace missing teeth. First the implant, then after healing, usually a few months later, a permanent crown.

procedures.name: All-on-4 and All-on-6
procedures.text: A fixed bridge on four or six implants when all or almost all teeth are missing.

procedures.name: Treatment and hygiene
procedures.text: Fillings, root canal treatment, cleaning and whitening, often alongside bigger treatment.

tx.plan_intro: An example plan for veneers or crowns. For implants you come twice. You get the exact day-by-day plan after the consultation.

plan.title: Arrival
plan.text: I meet you at the airport and take you to the hotel. You rest after the journey.

plan.title: Examination and preparation
plan.text: Examination, X-rays and a talk with the doctor. You agree on shape and shade. The doctor prepares the teeth and fits temporaries.

plan.title: Laboratory
plan.text: Technicians make your veneers or crowns. You have time to rest and see Istanbul.

plan.title: Fitting
plan.text: The doctor tries them in, refines the details and fixes them permanently. The bite is checked.

plan.title: Check-up and flight
plan.text: A final check-up before you fly. You get aftercare advice in your language, and we stay in touch after you get home.

prep: A panoramic X-ray of your teeth, if you have one
Photos of your smile from the front and side
A few words about what you want to change
Chronic conditions and medication you take
Your preferred travel dates

faq.q: Do I need an X-ray before I come?
faq.a: No, but it helps a lot. If you have a panoramic X-ray, send it and the first estimate will be more accurate. The clinic will do its own examination on site anyway.

faq.q: Veneers or crowns?
faq.a: The doctor decides after the examination, depending on the condition of your teeth. I interpret every option and explain the differences so the choice is fully yours.

faq.q: How many trips do implants take?
faq.a: Usually two. On the first, the doctor places the implants; on the second, after a few months of healing, the permanent crowns are fitted.

faq.q: What if something is wrong after I get home?
faq.a: Write to me straight away. I will pass photos and a description to the doctor and we will decide together what to do next.

tx.lead: Face and body procedures with experienced surgeons. I am with you at the consultation, on the day of surgery and throughout your recovery in Istanbul.
tx.wa: Hello Irena! I am interested in plastic surgery in Istanbul.

facts.label: in hospital, depending on the procedure

tx.proc_intro: I help with the most common plastic surgery procedures. What is possible in your case is up to the surgeon.

procedures.name: Rhinoplasty
procedures.text: Reshaping the nose, and sometimes improving breathing.

procedures.name: Breasts
procedures.text: Augmentation with implants, lift or reduction.

procedures.name: Liposuction
procedures.text: Removing local fat deposits and contouring the body.

procedures.name: Tummy tuck
procedures.text: Abdominoplasty: removing excess skin, often after major weight loss or pregnancy.

procedures.name: Eyelid surgery
procedures.text: Blepharoplasty: removing excess skin and bags around the eyes.

procedures.name: Face and neck lift
procedures.text: Rejuvenating the face and neck, sometimes together with other procedures.

tx.plan_intro: An example plan. How long you stay depends on the procedure and the surgeon's advice. You get the exact plan after the consultation.

plan.title: Arrival
plan.text: I meet you at the airport and take you to the hotel.

plan.title: Consultation and tests
plan.text: A talk with the surgeon and pre-operative tests. I interpret every question and every answer.

plan.title: Surgery
plan.text: I am at the hospital on the day of surgery. Afterwards you are cared for by the staff, usually for one or two nights.

plan.title: Rest
plan.text: You return to the hotel. We are in constant contact, and we go to check-ups together.

plan.title: Check-up and going home
plan.text: The surgeon checks your healing and decides when you can safely fly home.

prep: Photos of the area you want to change
Height and weight

Previous operations

faq.q: Will you be with me on the day of surgery?
faq.a: Yes. I am at the hospital, I talk to the doctor and the team, and after surgery I am with you. Throughout your stay you can message or call me at any time.

faq.q: When can I go back to work?
faq.a: It depends on the procedure and how you heal. The surgeon will tell you at the consultation, and I will interpret all the advice.

faq.q: Should I bring someone with me?
faq.a: For plastic surgery it is a good idea, though not necessary. I look after companions too.

faq.q: How should I prepare for surgery?
faq.a: Doctors usually ask you to stop smoking and some medication before surgery. I will pass on the exact instructions after the consultation.

tx.name: Hair transplant
tx.short: Istanbul is one of the world's most popular places for a hair transplant. I help you choose a doctor you can trust.
tx.meta_title: Hair transplant in Istanbul: FUE, DHI, beard and eyebrows | Irena
tx.meta_description: FUE and DHI hair transplants, beard and eyebrow transplants in Istanbul. Usually a 2–3 day stay, with personal support from the airport until you fly home. Free consultation.
tx.lead: Istanbul is one of the world's most popular places for a hair transplant. I help you choose a clinic and a doctor you can trust, and I am with you throughout your stay.
tx.wa: Hello Irena! I am interested in a hair transplant in Istanbul.

facts.label: for the procedure, under local anaesthetic

tx.proc_intro: The doctor chooses the method and number of grafts from your photos and an examination on site.

procedures.name: FUE
procedures.text: Individual hair follicles are taken and moved to where hair is missing.

procedures.name: Sapphire FUE
procedures.text: A variant of FUE in which the channels for the hair are made with a sapphire blade.

procedures.name: DHI
procedures.text: Follicles are implanted with a special tool, without opening channels first.

procedures.name: Beard transplant
procedures.text: A fuller beard and moustache, or filling areas where hair does not grow.

procedures.name: Eyebrow transplant
procedures.text: Fuller eyebrows or restoring their shape.

tx.plan_intro: An example plan. The procedure usually takes a whole day, and you can fly home after the first check-up.

plan.title: Arrival
plan.text: I meet you at the airport and take you to the hotel.

plan.title: Consultation and procedure
plan.text: A talk with the doctor, blood tests and drawing the hairline. Then the procedure under local anaesthetic.

plan.title: Check-up
plan.text: A check-up at the clinic, usually with the first wash. You get aftercare advice, and I interpret it.

plan.title: Flight home
plan.text: Your transfer to the airport is arranged.

plan.title: The result
plan.text: New hair starts growing after a few months; the full result usually shows after about a year. We stay in touch the whole time.

prep: Photos of your head: front, top, back and sides
How long you have been losing hair

faq.q: Does it hurt?
faq.a: The procedure is done under local anaesthetic. You will talk to the doctor about what to expect, and I will interpret every question.

faq.q: How many grafts will I need?
faq.a: The doctor gives a first estimate from your photos and a final one at the examination on site.

faq.q: When will I see the result?
faq.a: New hair starts growing after a few months. The full result usually shows after about a year.

faq.q: When can I go back to work?
faq.a: Many patients go back to work after a few days. The doctor will tell you what to be careful about in the first weeks.

facts.label: decides on eligibility, based on BMI and health

tx.proc_intro: The doctor chooses the type of surgery based on your weight, health and habits.

procedures.name: Gastric sleeve
procedures.text: The surgeon reduces the size of the stomach, so you feel full sooner.

procedures.name: Gastric bypass
procedures.text: A smaller stomach and a new route for food through the intestine.

procedures.name: Mini bypass
procedures.text: A simpler variant of the bypass with a single connection.

procedures.name: Gastric balloon
procedures.text: A non-surgical option: a balloon placed in the stomach for a few months.

tx.plan_intro: An example plan for surgery. You get the exact plan after the consultation with the doctor.

plan.title: Arrival
plan.text: I meet you at the airport and take you to the hotel or straight to the hospital.

plan.title: Tests and assessment
plan.text: Tests and talks with the surgeon and anaesthetist. I interpret every question.

plan.title: Surgery
plan.text: Usually keyhole surgery. I am at the hospital on the day of the operation.

plan.title: Hospital
plan.text: You are cared for by the staff and start a liquid diet. I visit you and interpret the advice.

plan.title: Check-up and going home
plan.text: A final check-up, a diet plan in your language and your flight home. We stay in touch afterwards.

prep: Height and current weight
Conditions such as diabetes or high blood pressure

Previous abdominal surgery

faq.q: Am I eligible for surgery?
faq.a: The doctor decides, based on your BMI, health conditions and tests. Send me your details and I will pass them on for a first assessment.

faq.q: What is the diet like after surgery?
faq.a: For the first weeks the diet is liquid, then puréed. The clinic gives you a nutrition plan and I will translate it.

faq.q: Can I bring someone with me?
faq.a: Yes, for bariatric surgery it is a good idea. I look after companions too.

faq.q: What happens after I get home?
faq.a: We stay in touch. If you have questions about your diet or how you feel, write to me and I will pass them to the doctor.

facts.label: usually the day after the procedure

tx.proc_intro: The doctor chooses the method after a detailed eye examination.

procedures.name: Laser vision correction
procedures.text: Methods such as LASIK, Femto-LASIK or SMILE for short-sightedness, long-sightedness and astigmatism.

procedures.name: PRK and LASEK
procedures.text: Surface methods, sometimes recommended for thinner corneas.

procedures.name: Cataract surgery
procedures.text: Removing the clouded lens and implanting an artificial one.

procedures.name: Lens replacement
procedures.text: Refractive lens exchange, for example with a multifocal lens, when laser is not the best choice.

tx.plan_intro: An example plan for laser vision correction. You get the exact plan after the consultation.

plan.title: Examination

plan.title: Procedure

plan.title: Check-up and going home
plan.text: A check-up with the doctor, usually the next day. The doctor decides when you can fly.

Whether you wear contact lenses, and which

faq.q: Do I need to stop wearing contact lenses?
faq.a: Usually yes, for some time before the examination. How long depends on the type of lens. I will tell you after the consultation.

faq.q: Can everyone have laser correction?
faq.a: No. The doctor decides after the examination, including measuring the cornea. If laser is not right for you, the doctor will suggest another method.

faq.q: When can I go home?
faq.a: Usually after the check-up the day after the procedure. The doctor makes the final call.

faq.q: Can I come on my own?
faq.a: Yes. I meet you at the airport and stay with you at the clinic, so you do not need to bring anyone.

sections.title: Flying to Istanbul
text: Flights from most European cities take 2–4 hours. There are direct flights from many cities, including London, Berlin, Amsterdam, Copenhagen and Warsaw.
Only buy your ticket once we have agreed on treatment dates. I will tell you which day is best to fly.

sections.title: Airports
text: Istanbul has two large airports: Istanbul Airport (IST) on the European side and Sabiha Gökçen (SAW) on the Asian side.
Either is fine. Send me your flight number and I will wait for you in the arrivals hall.

sections.title: Documents and visas
text: Citizens of most EU countries and the UK can visit Turkey visa-free for up to 90 days within 180 days.
Before you travel, check your government's travel advice for the current entry rules and passport validity requirements.

sections.title: Money
text: Turkey uses the Turkish lira (TRY). You can pay by card almost everywhere.
Change cash at an exchange office in the city (döviz in Turkish) rather than at the airport.

sections.title: Phone and internet
text: Turkey is not in the EU, so EU roaming does not apply and calls can be expensive.
Check your provider's travel bundle or get an eSIM or a Turkish SIM card. WhatsApp works on any Wi-Fi.

sections.title: Time and weather
text: Turkey is on UTC+3 all year. That is 2 hours ahead of Central Europe in winter and 1 hour in summer, and 3 or 2 hours ahead of the UK.
Spring and autumn are the most pleasant. Summer can be over 30°C. After some procedures, doctors advise avoiding the sun and swimming in the sea for a few weeks.

sections.title: What to pack
text: Light luggage is enough. The essentials:
list: ID or passport, and a photo of it on your phone
Test results and a list of your medication
Comfortable clothes; after face or head procedures, ideally ones that button up
A plug adapter if you come from the UK: Turkey uses European two-pin sockets
A bank card and some cash

sections.title: Insurance
text: Travel insurance is a good idea.
Standard policies often do not cover planned treatment. Check the terms with your insurer before you travel.

sections.title: Travelling with someone
text: About half of my patients come with someone close to them. It is a good idea, especially for bigger procedures.
I look after companions too: hotel, transfers and help on the spot.

guide.note: This information is a general guide and may change. Check the current rules before you travel.
guide.cta: Have a question that is not here? Write to me and I will reply within 24 hours.

items.q: How much does your help cost?
items.a: Nothing for you. The consultation and my support are free. You only pay for treatment and your stay, as quoted before you travel.

items.q: Why is your help free?
items.a: My work is paid for by the clinic I work with. You only pay for treatment and your stay.

items.q: Why is treatment cheaper in Turkey?
items.a: Running a clinic and labour cost less in Turkey than in Western Europe, and competition is strong. That is why treatment often costs 2–3 times less.

items.q: When will I know the price?
items.a: Before you travel. After the free consultation you get a treatment plan and a quote.

items.q: How do I start?
items.a: Message me on WhatsApp. Tell me what you are interested in and, if you can, attach photos or test results.

items.q: What should I send for a first estimate?
items.a: It depends on the treatment. For teeth, a panoramic X-ray helps; for a hair transplant, photos of your head from several sides. I will tell you exactly what I need.

items.q: Can I talk to the doctor before I come?
items.a: Often, yes. Sometimes I arrange a video consultation with the doctor and interpret the conversation.

items.q: Why are there no clinic names on the site?
items.a: I work with many clinics and hospitals in Istanbul and choose the doctor for each patient. After the consultation I will tell you exactly where and with whom you will be treated.

items.q: How long do I have to decide?
items.a: As long as you need. Many patients decide within about two weeks, some straight away. I never push.

items.q: Do you speak English?
items.a: Some English. I work mainly in Polish, Ukrainian, Russian and Turkish.

items.q: Do I need a visa?
items.a: Citizens of most EU countries, including Poland, can stay in Turkey visa-free for up to 90 days. If you are not sure about your country, ask me.

items.q: How long will I stay in Istanbul?
items.a: It depends on the treatment: usually 2–3 days for a hair transplant, 5–10 days for veneers, 7–10 days for plastic surgery. You get a day-by-day plan after the consultation.

items.q: Will you pick me up at the airport?
items.a: Yes. Send me your flight number and I will wait in the arrivals hall.

items.q: Can I bring someone with me?
items.a: Of course. About half of my patients come with someone close to them. I look after them too.

items.q: I live in the UK or Germany. Can you help me?
items.a: Yes. I help patients from all over Europe, including the UK, Germany, the Netherlands and Denmark.

items.q: Is treatment in Turkey safe?
items.a: Every procedure carries risks, at home and in Turkey. That is why choosing the doctor matters so much. I choose a doctor experienced in your treatment, and you discuss the risks with them before you decide. I interpret every word.

items.q: How do you choose the doctor?
items.a: I consider their experience in your treatment, my patients' feedback, conditions at the clinic and your budget.

items.q: Will I understand everything the doctor says?
items.a: Yes. I am there for every conversation and interpret it. You can ask anything.

items.q: What if something worries me during my stay?
items.a: Call or message me at any time. Throughout your stay I am available 24/7, and if needed we go to the clinic together.

items.q: What if something worries me after I get home?
items.a: Write to me. We stay in touch after you get home, and if needed I pass your questions on to the doctor.

items.q: Can I come back for another treatment?
items.a: Of course. Many of my patients come back for further treatment and bring their loved ones.

items.q: When do you reply to messages?
items.a: Within 24 hours, Monday to Saturday. On Sundays I rest.
